_comment: The deployed site's settings (deploy plan D4; several runs, review plan R0; D and G, R5): read by api/index.py, never secret. The environment overrides each; no key belongs here. Banners are Bhargavi's; {start_rank} is filled from the served shortlist.

GUIDEWORD_DEMO_RUNS.banner: This plant is rebuilt from the public CSB report on the 2013 Williams Olefins explosion (2 killed). The plant file doesn't say what happened. Line #{start_rank} is the accident Guideword found.
Unit D: a butadiene extraction unit, described in a written plant data package. A development case: its expected answer is kept in a separate key the tool never sees.
Plant G: a silicone emulsions batch plant, described in a written plant data package. A development case: its expected answer is kept in a separate key the tool never sees.
